en.answer: If the effect of <<9971>> is activated using the effect of <<6660>>, the entire effect that Special Summons the Photon Tokens, but prevent them from attacking or being used as <<9241>> monsters is applied normally. (However, during that turn, you can still Summon monsters other than LIGHT monsters.)
en.question: If the card revealed by the effect of <<6660>> is <<9971>>, and during the Main Phase of my next turn, I activate the effect of <<9971>>, how does it resolve?
en.title: If the card revealed by the effect of <<6660>> is <<9971>>, and during the Main Phase of my next turn, I activate the effect of <<9971>>, how does it resolve?

ja.answer:
「<<6660>>」の効果によって「<<9971>>」の効果を発動した場合、その特殊召喚された「フォトントークン」は攻撃する事ができず、シンクロ素材とする事もできません。
（ただし、このターンに自分は光属性以外のモンスターも召喚・反転召喚・特殊召喚する事ができます。）
